findings.description: A household member can reset protocol 4 state to protocol 3 migration and revision zero.
findings.root_cause: The migration guard accepts all protocol versions except 3.
findings.impact: Possible sync disruption and inconsistent revision history; data loss is not runtime-confirmed.
findings.fix: Allow protocol 3 migration only from legacy protocol 1 or 2.
findings.verification: Regression failed against the original rule; all 8 Firestore emulator tests passed with the fix.
